title: The Rabbit Sends in a Little Bill

segments.ch04.s0200: In a tidy little room, a little bottle stood near the looking-glass.
segments.ch04.s0210: There was no label this time.
segments.ch04.s0220: But she uncorked it and put it to her lips.
segments.ch04.s0230: Something interesting is sure to happen whenever I eat or drink anything.
segments.ch04.s0240: I do hope it will make me grow large again.
segments.ch04.s0250: It did so indeed, and much sooner than she had expected.
segments.ch04.s0260: Before she had drunk half the bottle, her head was pressing against the ceiling.
segments.ch04.s0280: I do wish I had not drunk quite so much!
segments.ch04.s0290: Alas, it was too late to wish that.
segments.ch04.s0300: She went on growing, and growing.
segments.ch04.s0310: Very soon she had to kneel down on the floor.
segments.ch04.s0320: Then she lay down with one elbow against the door and one arm round her head.
segments.ch04.s0340: As a last resource, she put one arm out of the window, and one foot up the chimney.
segments.ch04.s0350: Now I can do no more, whatever happens.
segments.ch04.s0370: Luckily the little bottle had now had its full effect, and she grew no larger.
segments.ch04.s0380: The Rabbit came up to the door and tried to open it.
segments.ch04.s0390: But the door opened inwards, and her elbow was pressed hard against it.
segments.ch04.s0400: Then I will go round and get in at the window.
segments.ch04.s0420: She waited till she heard the Rabbit just under the window.
segments.ch04.s0430: Then she suddenly spread out her hand, and made a snatch in the air.
segments.ch04.s0440: She heard a little shriek, and a fall, and a crash of broken glass.
segments.ch04.s0450: It had fallen into a cucumber-frame, or something of the sort.
segments.ch04.s0470: At last came a rumbling of little cartwheels, and a good many voices.
segments.ch04.s0480: Bill is to go down the chimney!
segments.ch04.s0490: So Bill has got to come down the chimney, has he?
segments.ch04.s0500: They seem to put everything upon Bill.
segments.ch04.s0510: This fireplace is narrow, to be sure, but I think I can kick a little!
segments.ch04.s0520: She drew her foot as far down the chimney as she could, and waited.
segments.ch04.s0530: A little animal came scratching and scrambling down the chimney just above her.
segments.ch04.s0570: Catch him, you by the hedge!
segments.ch04.s0580: Then silence, and then another confusion of voices.
segments.ch04.s0590: Hold up his head, brandy now, do not choke him!
segments.ch04.s0600: Last came a little feeble, squeaking voice.
segments.ch04.s0620: I am a deal too flustered to tell you.
segments.ch04.s0630: Something comes at me like a Jack-in-the-box, and up I go like a sky-rocket!
segments.ch04.s0640: So you did, old fellow, said the others.
